trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 describing what happened.

- **Rollback:** Release v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. It had also been unhealthy in staging (as v2.3.1-rc). v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to it. Afterwards all three regions were running v2.3.0, health checks were passing and the error rate was 0.2%.
- **Incident:** The first attempt to create the incident failed with a temporary "service unavailable" error. I'd attached a unique request key, so retrying couldn't open a second incident. The retry worked: INC-0001 is open and the on-call engineer has been paged. It says what failed, what I rolled back, the current health status, and that the cause of the v2.3.1 failure needs to be found before it's redeployed.
